voice: TARGONA: compassionate, humble angel and soldier; direct desire finally spoken when the ward has emptied. Emotional initiative without sermon, moral certificate or apology. Tenderness has practical weight: hands still accustomed to dressings, a lamp, a blanket, an actual lover. Retrospective epilogue voice, concise and concrete. No generic triumphant redemption, narrator maxim, HR speech or sanctification of sex. Write new dialogue; do not reuse the example.
facts:

scene: Postwar Trickster epilogue, Drezen drying loft as the last cots are folded. Only Targona and a living or already-earned-returned Commander. Existing late-commitment outcome with mutual attraction, not a colleague, closed/refused history, unreturned sacrifice, or previously committed first night. BEFORE: Targona asks; the Commander answers by taking her offered hand; she leads upstairs, undresses and draws the Commander onto the blanket. INTERVAL: mutual intimacy described as a brief retrospective epilogue passage through kisses, warmth and chosen closeness, without graphic sexual description. REQUIRED BEATS: her initiative is answered, she puts the cloth aside, she wants this particular person and does not apologize for wanting; keep the setting of the last bandages being taken down rather than another active medical vigil. Use N lines for third-person epilogue narration ('the Commander'), not second-person adventure narration. T may speak briefly, no Commander dialogue inside her node. End exactly at last_line. AFTER: original morning feather/Wilcer/new infirmary payoff, no duplicate morning or added mechanic. No oath, miracle, transformation, pregnancy, flag or extra participant. Preserve the original epilogue Continue exit identity and effects. PHYSICAL CONTINUITY: silver hair; a natural white-feathered wing. Leave the altered side undescribed across treatment histories; never invent black feathers or restored anatomy.
last_line: N: Before dawn she caught the Commander's sleeve for one last kiss, then found her smock beneath the blanket. Wilcer Garms found a white feather on the ladder and wrote in his ledger. When the new infirmary opened near the Commander's house, she hung that feather over the door.
example:
N: Targona set the folded linen beside the lamp and turned back to the Commander.
T: I have wanted to ask you for so long.
N: Her offered hand was taken, and she answered with a kiss.
after_text: {n}Targona drew the Commander down beside her, smiling against the next kiss. The last bandages swayed above the blanket.{/n}
